description:
This application is for the localized re-rendering, repriming  and repainting of the white lower portion (water table) of 25 Almeida street's two external walls, including window frames and window sills, at the intersection of Almeida street and Battishill street. This application specifically EXCLUDES 25 Almeida street's portico and brick walls.

The contractor's advice is that the actual extent of defective wall render can only be established once the loose coating is removed, and it is not currently known whether the percentage of wall re-rendering required will exceed 25%.This application is made to cover the eventuality that 25% or more of the wall re-render may be required, to ensure that the necessary work can proceed uninterrupted, irrespective of the percentage wall re-render required.

In line with Barnsbury Conservation Area Design Guidelines, and to preserve architectural uniformity, the proposed work will exclusively use lime-based render or insulating lime render if/where required as a proportional path to improving the walls thermal performance. Original wall and windows features will strictly be preserved.

Mobile scaffolding will be installed in the house's lightwell under street level to provide workers' access to the water table.
decision_conditions:
3 YEAR CONSENT PERIOD:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
